title: Checkpoint
description: A snapshot of agent or execution state at a specific point in time. Checkpoints enable verifiable resume and form the basis for fork provenance.

checkpoint_id.description: Globally-unique identifier for this checkpoint. Recommended format: <run_id>-<nonce> or <run_id>-<state_digest_prefix>.

state_digest.description: Deterministic content digest of the checkpointed execution state. Used for tamper-evident resume verification.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this checkpoint was created.

parent_run_id.description: Identifier of the execution run this checkpoint belongs to.

oneOf.description: checkpoint_id of the parent checkpoint this run was forked from.
Structured reference to the parent checkpoint.

fork_of.description: When present, indicates this checkpoint was derived from an existing checkpoint (i.e. this is a fork). Omit for non-fork checkpoints.
